name: proposed-cef-shutdown-fix-for-pages-that-660da16f
purpose: Will you run the 20-second listening check now? You start handoff/macos-completion/validation/listening-check.sh by hand from the repository root. About 4 seconds in you should hear one short quiet tone (0.5 s, 660 Hz), then 2 seconds later the words 'listening check', under 3 seconds of sound in total from the Mac's default output. Afterwards say whether each was heard once, from which speaker, and anything doubled or missing.

communication.title: Proposed CEF shutdown fix for pages that select an audio output device
